event: Nala hands Dickon's belt to Jory.

changes.note: Nala hands Dickon's belt to Jory at the weir
Dickon's belt stays with Jory at Hobb's weir

event: He takes it with a bow of the head. "I'll carry it to his mother at Brennock Ford."

memory.fact: Jory takes Dickon's belt with a bow of the head; he'll carry it to Dickon's mother at Brennock Ford.

event: "The Wend Maid owes you passage anywhere on the Wend, any time. Free."

memory.fact: Jory tells Nala the Wend Maid owes her passage anywhere on the Wend, any time, free.

event: Nala takes the towpath back north under the willows; the walk passes quietly.

memory.fact: The towpath back from Hobb's Mill passes quietly on day 8.
A flat towpath runs the Wend's east bank from Wendlow to Hobb's Mill, under willows.

event: A little before half past two she reaches Wendlow's gate, mouth dry from the road.

changes.note: Two hours' walk fills her mana again

memory.fact: The walk back from Hobb's Mill brings Nala to Wendlow's gate a little before 14:30.

event: The watch knows her now. She pays her copper and is waved through with a grin.

memory.fact: At the gate the watch knows her now; she pays her copper and is waved through with a grin.

event: At Antler Hall she unwraps the two hooked, yellow-white fangs on the counter.
Grete turns one over. "Eighty pounds of head is too much to haul. These will do."

memory.fact: Grete counts an 80-pound wyrm head too big to carry; she pays the Weir Wyrm's bounty on its fangs.

event: "Box is empty since your last lot," she says, and writes a chit for fifteen gold.

memory.fact: The Board's strongbox is empty since Nala's payout; for the wyrm Grete writes a 15-gold chit.
Nala turned in the Weir Wyrm's fangs at Antler Hall; she carries Grete's signed 15-gold chit.

event: "Paid with the other when the tax rider comes tomorrow." She signs it and slides it over.

memory.fact: The wyrm's 15-gold chit is paid with the other from the magistrate's purse when the tax rider comes.

event: She hangs the fangs on a nail beside Voss's head and wipes the Weir Wyrm off the Board.

changes.note: Nala turns the wyrm's fangs in at Antler Hall
Grete hangs the fangs on a nail in Antler Hall

memory.fact: Grete hangs the wyrm's fangs on a nail beside Voss's head and wipes the wyrm off the Board.

event: "That letter went to the magistrate yesterday," she adds, low. "That's all I'll say of it."

memory.fact: Asked nothing, Grete says only that the letter went to the magistrate yesterday, and no more of it.

event: "Board's bare till the rider brings fresh slips tomorrow," Grete says, and dips her pen in the ink.

memory.fact: Grete says the Board is bare till the rider brings fresh slips, and dips her pen in the ink.
No new contract is posted on day 8; Grete expects fresh slips with the tax rider on day 9.
